interface.longDescription: A Codex adaptation of DaoBrew's Claude Code 10x-engineer toolkit. It installs the skill workflow layer for brainstorming, implementation planning, TDD, systematic debugging, subagent-driven development, code review, branch finishing, and verification. Claude-specific commands, agents, and hooks remain in the source package for Claude Code but are intentionally omitted from the Codex manifest.
